What Good Is a Chassis Cab?

Chassis cabs offer flexibility first and foremost. They let you upfit your truck to fit your unique business needs. Whether you need a dump truck for on-the-job hauling or a crane upfit for utility repairs, a cab chassis truck can give you what you need to get the job done in or beyond. Here are some possible chassis cab configurations:

items.label: Ambulance:
items.desc: Cab chassis trucks can be upfitted with an ambulance box for use in the medical field, giving them tremendous value to society.

items.label: Recreational Vehicle:
items.desc: Cab chassis trucks can be equipped with a recreational vehicle box, making them useful all around Riviera Beach and Ft. Pierce, or wherever you want to travel!

items.label: Crane Upfit:
items.desc: Upfit your chassis cab truck with a crane upfit and you can use it for utility repairs or other commercial or construction purposes.

items.label: Dump Truck:
items.desc: Dump trucks are widely used in the contracting and construction industries, and they usually start off as a chassis cab truck.

items.label: Flatbed:
items.desc: Used for hauling purposes, flatbeds offer supreme versatility, and they most often start off as chassis cab trucks!
